title: Canonical coefficient and positive Tate-line maps
statement: For prime $\ell$, finite subextensions and their integer coefficients are those of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. In the module-object categories of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category], use the integral, rational and algebraic-closure positive lines of [sk-def-sp-tate-twist]. The $\mathbf Z_\ell$ line is the bottom finite subextension's integral line restricted along the actual continuous $\mathbf Z_\ell\to\mathcal O_{\mathbf Q_\ell}$ coefficient map. Its map to each integral line is the published root-projection-normalized bottom-field transition. The map from an integral line to its rational line is the ordinary balanced-tensor extension unit. The map from each rational line to the closure line is its specified coprojection into the sheafified finite-field colimit. All coefficient maps are the actual continuous ring maps, and their ring-map structures are retained.
